**Finding: compliant (no redline proposed).**

Paragraph 22 of the APCN 2 C&MA satisfies the ASSIGN fallback on its material terms, and partly exceeds it:

- **Successor assignment (mutual):** 22.3(a) lets any Party, including Teleglobe USA Inc., assign the whole of its rights and obligations to a successor without consent.
- **Affiliate assignment without consent:** 22.3(b)–(d) and the one-time partial assignment in 22.4 extend that freedom to Parent Companies, Subsidiaries and Affiliates — the preferred-level Customer freedom, which we deliberately left intact rather than narrowing it to the literal fallback.
- **Written notice:** 22.6 requires timely written notice to all other Parties for any exercise of 22.2–22.5.
- **Consent for other assignments, reasonableness-qualified:** 22.1 bars other assignments, 22.2 permits them with prior written Management Committee consent that "must not unreasonably withhold or delay its approval."
- **No change-of-control exit:** the Agreement contains no change-of-control trigger at all; the only exit is the symmetrical natural-term notice right in 18.1, which belongs to duration/renewal rather than to this rule.

Noted, not flagged: consent runs to the Management Committee rather than to us individually, there is no prohibition on assignment to a competitor of ours, and "successor", "Affiliate" and "Parent Company" are undefined, so merger/asset-sale coverage relies on the ordinary meaning of "successor".
